_comment: Locked character Elements for Petal Pals. Embed the id in a generation prompt as <<<id>>> and the backend injects that character's locked reference — this is what keeps the cast identical across every shot and every episode. Never describe a character's design in a shot prompt; reference the Element instead, or the two descriptions will fight and the character will drift.
style: bright glossy 3D cartoon, soft rounded shapes, thick clean dark outlines, big expressive eyes, appealing exaggerated toddler-show proportions, soft global illumination, wholesome and cozy, saturated candy colors

poppy.name: pp-poppy
poppy.note: Reads as a human toddler in a ladybug costume rather than an insect. Approved deliberately 2026-08-09.

sprout.name: pp-sprout-1leaf
sprout.note: EXACTLY ONE leaf — this is the Ep1 state. The model strongly prefers giving him a leaf pair, so every generation must be checked. A new Element is needed per episode as the count grows: 1 (Ep1) → 2 (Ep2) → 3 → 4 → 5 (finale).

drizzle.name: pp-drizzle
drizzle.note: Ep1 uses him only distant and small. Full reveal is Ep2. He brightens across the season, so later episodes will need their own Elements.

supersededElements._comment: Pre-existing Petal Pals Elements found in the workspace, created ~2026-08-03. They are PHOTOREALISTIC and do not match the bible's cartoon style; the snail and seedling in particular read as uncanny for a 2-6 audience. Left in place, not deleted, but not used. Do not mix these with the pp-* set.

siblingShow._comment: Nightlight Squad Elements also exist in this workspace — the sister show named in the bible. Untouched.
